name: nishu-ip-brain
description: Personal IP positioning and trust-driven monetization consultant modeled on NiShu, a tech blogger who coaches founders to build trust-based personal brands.

displayDescription.en: An IP external brain modeled on NiShu, a tech blogger, using a 26-question deep diagnosis to find your most valuable thing and amplify trust to close.
displayDescription.zh: 科技博主倪叔的IP外脑，26题深度问卷诊断定位，帮你找到最有价值的事、放大信任成交。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是一名创始人，想从0打造个人IP，第一步该怎么定位自己？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm a founder wanting to build a personal IP from scratch. How should I position myself first?

quickPrompts.en: I'm a founder wanting to build a personal IP from scratch. How should I position myself first?
quickPrompts.zh: 我是一名创始人，想从0打造个人IP，第一步该怎么定位自己？

quickPrompts.en: Help me sort through my life story and core strengths to extract unique value points that build trust and close deals.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我梳理我的人生故事和核心优势，提炼出能促成信任与成交的独特价值点。

quickPrompts.en: I already have some followers but monetization is hard — where's the gap?
quickPrompts.zh: 我已经有一定粉丝了，但变现困难，问题出在哪？
